column1: # wages.tsv -- GENERATED, and EMPTY: no wage generator exists yet.
# Framework only. The intended contents are offline aggregations of two key-free
# US government datasets, restricted to employers already matched in
#   * DOL OFLC LCA/PERM disclosure files (source=oflc): what an employer
#     certified it would pay for a role in a state, aggregated to
#     (employer, soc, area) -> {n, p25, p50, p75} annualized USD.
#   * BLS OEWS flat files (source=oews): survey estimates by occupation and
#     area, national and state tiers only. Metro is ~330k rows and does not
# THESE ARE NOT PAY. A benchmark row is a third party's statement about an
# occupation or about somebody else's visa application. It must never be written
# into JobPosting.Compensation and must never satisfy --min-pay; see
# docs/compensation.md ("Nothing blends sources") and the WageBenchmark doc
# Raw disclosure files are hundreds of thousands of rows per fiscal year and are
# never shipped: only the aggregate lands here.
